concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-internal-fund-transfers-approve-cancel-transfers]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace optional transfer-review guide for approval, cancellation, 30-day expiry and webhooks; example payloads are bank transfers, not internal two-leg booking proof.
warnings: The guide is under internal fund transfers, but the detailed review webhook payloads are bank-scoped TEST examples; do not generalize their account mutations or event sequence to internal booked transfers.
Approval authorizes continued processing; HTTP 200 or authorised review status is not evidence of completed internal movement or bank receipt.
